Dates must come from the article body, not a listing page: FAS listing pages mis-attribute dates. `time` is optional and Asia/Singapore — state it only when the source does; never invent one. Validated by checks/news-audit.mjs on every push.

items.title: FC Jurong open 2026/27 SPL season under its new name, with Honda poised for Singapore debut
items.summary: FC Jurong — the club formerly known as Albirex Niigata Singapore, then briefly Albirex Jurong FC — played its first competitive match under its current name and crest away to Young Lions at Jalan Besar Stadium on 13 September, with former Japan international Keisuke Honda in line for his first competitive Singapore Premier League appearance since signing. The rebrand, finalised in April 2026, keeps a swan nodding to the old 'White Swans' identity but recolours it orange as the club roots itself in Jurong. It is not yet confirmed whether the club's grassroots academy arm has adopted the same rebrand — see action list.

items.title: Manchester City beat 10-man derby-opponents Manchester United 1-0 at Old Trafford
items.summary: Manchester City won 1-0 away to Manchester United in the season's first Manchester derby, new City boss Enzo Maresca's first meeting with the club's biggest rivals. Erling Haaland's goal — awarded after a VAR review overturned an initial offside call — proved decisive; City played over an hour with ten men after Phil Foden was sent off in the 23rd minute, but held on to keep City on top of the early Premier League table.

items.title: SPL's 30th season kicks off with record S$1m prize pot and new Hawk-Eye VAR
items.summary: The 2026/27 Singapore Premier League season began on 11 September, the league's 30th edition, with a total prize pot of S$1 million — up 67% from S$600,000 the previous season — and bigger rewards spread further down the table. The league has also partnered with Hawk-Eye Innovations, a Sony Group company, to roll out Video Assistant Referee technology across all eight SPL clubs and matches for the first time.

items.title: Champions League's new league-phase season opens with goal-laden Matchday 1
items.summary: The 2026/27 UEFA Champions League league phase kicked off across 8–10 September and runs until January 2027. Bayern München (5-0 over Bodø/Glimt), Manchester United (4-0 over Sabah), Barcelona (5-1 over Feyenoord) and Paris Saint-Germain (6-1 over Slovan Bratislava) posted big wins, while Real Madrid edged Inter 2-1 and Arsenal scraped past Napoli 1-0. PSG's Ferran Torres, who scored a hat-trick against Slovan Bratislava, was named Matchday 1's standout player.

items.title: Gavin Lee names a 25-man Lions squad for the ASEAN Hyundai Cup 2026
items.summary: Head coach Gavin Lee confirmed the 25 players representing Singapore at the ASEAN Championship Hyundai Cup 2026, which runs from 24 July to 26 August. The Lions open their Group A campaign away to Cambodia in Phnom Penh on Friday 24 July, return home to face Timor-Leste on 27 July, then travel to defending champions Vietnam on 31 July.

items.title: Tickets released for Singapore's ASEAN Hyundai Cup home fixtures at Jalan Besar Stadium
items.summary: FAS put tickets for the Lions' home Group A fixture against Timor-Leste on sale at 11am, with tickets for the 7 August home fixture against Indonesia following on Wednesday 22 July, also at 11am. Both fixtures are at Jalan Besar Stadium.
